lead_independence.headline: Woman arrested after stealing Broward Sheriff's cruiser, fleeing to St. Lucie County on I-95
lead_independence.lead: A Fort Lauderdale woman was arrested Tuesday night after allegedly stealing a marked Broward County Sheriff's Office patrol car and abandoning it on Interstate 95 in St. Lucie County near Gatlin Boulevard.
